newsitem.title: INDIA: BUDGET HIGHLIGHTS -India customs duty proposals.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET HIGHLIGHTS -India customs duty proposals.

text.p: Following are the highlights of customs duties announced by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in the annual budget for 1997/98 (April-March) on Friday.
* The Finance Minister, P. Chidambaram has proposed to reduce the peak rate of customs duty from the present 50 percent to 40 percent in his budget for 1997-98.
However, items like dried grapes, alcolohic beverages, hall or roller berings, passenger baggage and imports by couriers are not covered under this.
* The customs duty on baggage has been proposed to be reduced from 60% to 50%.

* Presenting the indirect tax proposal to be reduced from 60% to 50%, in the Lok Sabha today, Shri P.Chidambarm said that efforts have been made to harmonise the need of Indian industry with the requirements of the capital goods sector.
Accordingly a reduction from 25 percent to 20 percent has been proposed on import of capital goods, including project imports.
MAJOR PROPOSALS INVOLVING CHANGES IN RATES OF CUSTOMS DUTY ARE AS UNDER:-
* Plans, designs and drawings are exempted from customs duty.
* Inputs for steel industry will attract lower custom duty.
* Reduction in custom duty on cooking coal of ash content less than 12 percent from 5 percent to 3 percent coal and coke from 20 percent to 10 percent.
* Full exemption from custom duty on computer software and braille printers/embossers and braille displays specially designed for computer systems.
* Reduction in custom duty on computer parts other than populated printed circuit boards from 20 percent to 10 percent on populated printed circuit boards from 30 percent to 20 percent.
* Reduction in duty on cartridge tape drive and digital video disc drive from 20 percent to 10 percent.
* Reduction in duty on integrated circuits from 20 percent 10 percent color monitor tubes from 20 percent to 10 percent.
* Reduction in duty on color picture tubes from 35 percent to 30 percent parts of cellular telephones and pagers from 30 percent to 20 percent.
* Reduction in duty on telecom equipment from 40 percent to 30 percent and on their parts from 30 percent to 20 percent.

* Duty on watch parts and movements reduced from 50 percent to 20 percent clocks and watch parts from 50 percent to 25 percent and on watch cases and base metals from 50 percent to 30 percent. Duty on horological materials is proposed to be reduced from 20 percent to 10 percent.

* The customs duty on CNG kits and their parts is proposed to be reduced from 10 percent to 5 percent on catalytic converters and their parts to a sharp decrease of 5 percent from the existing 25 percent.

* Duty on medical quipment is proposed to be reduced to 20 percent from 30 percent, full exemption from duty on linear acceleration of 15 MeV and above used from cancer treatment on ophthalmic blanks for making spectacle lense from 50 percent to 20 percent.
* Full exemption has been proposed for specified goods imported for the manufacture of ELISA kits; on specified life saving drugs/medicines and diagnostic kits for personal use by air/post.
* Reduction in customs duty on homeopathic drugs from 25 percent to 20 percent.
* Import duty on specified equipment for hotel industry reduced from 30 percent to 25 percent on specified speciality food items used by foreign tourist from 50 percent to 25 percent.
* Import duty on cine films and other photographic films reduced from 30 percent to 25 percent on part of cameras from 50 percent to 25 percent.
* A concession duty of 10 percent has been proposed for imports of components and parts of textile machinery.

* Reduction in custon duty on dyes, pigment (other than based on titaniun dioxide), paints and varnishes from 40 percent to 30 percent on albuminoidal substances, glues, enzymes and modified straches from 40 perent to 30 percent.
* Reduction in duty on apparel grade wool from 25 percent to 20 percent, wool waste from 30 to 20 percent and on sythetic rages from 30 percent to 25 percent.
* Full exemption from duty on amonia for non fertilizer use, raw, tenned or dressed furskins of lamps, wood logs, fuel wood and wood charcoal.

* Duty reduction in organic and inorganic chemicals from 40 percent to 30 percent on linear alkylbenzene, naphthalene and methanol from 30 percent to 20 percent and on phenol and catalysts from 30 percent to 25 percent.
